values.note: Full hookup site $58 a night, $350 a week (seventh day free), $910 a month plus electric; tents $28 with electric and water. Rates cover 4 adults (or 2 adults and 4 children); extra guests $3 each.

fees.source: https://redgatesrv.com/reservations/ (rate table 'Full Hookup Site $58.00 $350.00 $910+ electric', 'Tents (up to 4 people) $28 electric & water $160.00', 'RV Site Rates are for 4 adults ... Additional guests are $3 per person'; page modified 2026-06-06), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://redgatesrv.com/ ('20 Large Lots equipped w/ full hookups (30 and 50 amp)'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://redgatesrv.com/ ('20 Large Lots equipped w/ full hookups') + https://redgatesrv.com/reservations/ ('We can accommodate RVs up to 44 ft long'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve through the camp hosts at (828) 685-8787 or by email; a credit card holds the site, and a no-show or cancellation inside 48 hours costs one night. Holidays (Garden Jubilee, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) need 3 nights. Check-in 3-8pm.

booking.source: https://redgatesrv.com/reservations/ ('Please contact our campgrounds hosts to make a reservation at (828) 685-8787 or email', 'Holidays require a 3 day minimum stay (Garden Jubilee, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day)') + https://redgatesrv.com/ ('Reservations are recommended'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://redgatesrv.com/reservations/ ('Passport America members are half price Sunday through Wednesday as available ... Passport America is valid for 2 nights per month maximum'), read 2026-10-22

note: Small RV park on rolling meadowland 5.5 miles from downtown Hendersonville, with a 2-acre stocked lake, dog park, fire pits and shuffleboard; tents welcome. GPS may send you to an impassable service entrance: follow Sugar Loaf Road about 2.5 miles to the Red Gates Tent & RV Park sign. --Claude
summary: Operator site (rates page modified 2026-06-06): confirmed $58 full hookup, 20 lots 30/50-amp, open April 1 - November 1. Changed max rig 45 -> 44 ('up to 44 ft'). Added phone reservations, holiday 3-night minimum, Passport America half price Sun-Wed. Note cleaned (field facts and the 45-ft figure dropped, GPS entrance warning kept).
